summary: The actual upstream Field::prepare raises the reported exception for all four old direct fields. Fixed nested container fields prepare as native select/input components. Native factory metadata merging gives eight fields for the baseline and exactly four for the fixed XML in both merge directions. Controlled EAV metadata options, labels, scopes, use-default helpers, disabled state and validation remain intact. In default merge order EAV notices win; reverseMetadataMerge preserves XML notices. Both orders tested.
limitations: No installed Magento application, database, EAV setupAttributeMeta execution, ObjectManager, DI compile, full product edit page render, product save, frontend HTTP, browser, FPM or SMTP. Native sources are unmodified tagged upstream files; explicit adapters, doubles and constructor bypasses are listed for each result.

results.scope: Unmodified native definition.map XML converter, layout argument Parser/Flat converter, Ui Config Converter/Composite/ArrayType/XpathType/ConverterUtils, UiComponentFactory mergeMetadataItem/mergeMetadataElement/argumentsResolver and Ui Form Field/Select/Input/AbstractComponent/Processor prepare methods execute. Config storage, definitions, element factory and UI context are adapters/doubles. Scalar/array argument evaluation is an explicit double. Select and UiComponentFactory constructors are bypassed by reflection. EAV metadata is a controlled fixture following the native Eav container naming; Eav::setupAttributeMeta, EAV database, ObjectManager, full HTML render, HTTP, browser, product save and server/FPM are NOT RUN.
